title: Corebridge helps students and educators start the school year strong
summary: Corebridge helped K-12 students and educators start the school year strong with volunteer support, classroom resources and school supply donations.
body_markdown:
This back-to-school season, Corebridge supported students, educators and schools across the country to help them prepare for a strong start to the year.


Corebridge colleagues packed healthy snacks and hygiene kits, created mindfulness and early literacy resources, filled backpacks and helped refresh school spaces.


Through its partnership with Kids In Need Foundation (KINF), Corebridge also provided essential school supplies to students and educators in K-12 school districts nationwide.


Corebridge staff personally delivered donations to schools, connecting with educators and thanking them for the work they do every day.


“Back-to-school season is a time of optimism and opportunity, and Corebridge is proud to help students and educators begin the year with confidence,” said Shanda Vangas, Corporate Social Responsibility Vice President for Corebridge. “By supporting schools, we’re giving back to the communities where we live and serve, helping build stronger futures and honoring the educators whose dedication makes such a meaningful difference every day.”
